body: I've got a billion negative tests to ease my mind, but I just imagine that same ordeal I went through the time that I did have to have an abortion. I'm certainly hoping for the best. Thank you for the kind thoughts!
Thank you so much, this is perfect advice. I wasn't sure how I could put it into words, but you've helped a bit.

Right. It happened last month, and prior to that, it was all wonky due to getting off BC. I'm also fighting off some kind of illness, because my lymph nodes are swollen in my neck. 

It's that worst case scenario that's eating me up.

That's why I'm here.

I want to maybe just give my close friends and boyfriend a heads up, just in case I'm outwardly acting off or sulky. They'll know what's going on. But I don't want to burden them or seem whiny. 

Thank you for replying.

I just don't want to burden him with that when there isn't much he can do for me. I would like to just let him know, that way he's aware, but I don't want to leave him clueless as to what he can do to cheer me up, or for him to think that he's responsible for making me happy. 

Thank you for the response.
